results.criterion: With GIS settled and the catalogue at its top position, entering `Surveyor` in Search layers keeps that query in the field and shows the matching Surveyor catalogue entry.

Opened GIS; waited for map and catalogue to settle at top.
Entered Surveyor in Search layers.
Observed Surveyor retained in field and matching Surveyor (1) catalogue entry.
Captured final GIS state and URL, then cleared query and captured cleanup.
results.reason: Surveyor query and matching entry were directly visible.

results.criterion: After searching for `Surveyor` from the initial top-of-catalogue view, clearing the query empties the search field and restores the same entries and browsing controls visible in that initial viewport at the same browsing position.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher and captured independent initial state.
Opened GIS and waited for settled map/catalogue.
Captured initial top catalogue viewport; both catalogue scroll containers were at 0.
Entered Surveyor and verified filtered matching entry.
Cleared query; observed empty field and identical initial visible entries, group controls, positions and scroll offsets.
Captured restored final GIS viewport and current URL.
results.reason: Initial viewport restored; catalogue scroll offsets remained 0. Scope excludes off-screen and clipped entries.

results.criterion: From the settled initial GIS view, the visible map retains its initial extent and scale both while the `Surveyor` query is present and after it is cleared.
steps_taken: First sequence was setup: original baseline showed a Loading indicator, so restarted independently from launcher for a settled baseline.
Captured second launcher initial state and opened GIS; scale wait initially timed out while hidden, then Loading disappeared and screenshot confirmed settled map.
Captured settled second baseline: initial map view #/-0.30002/50.85213/12.16, scale 1 km.
Entered Surveyor; verified catalogue result, captured map and unchanged browser-derived map view and scale.
Cleared query; verified catalogue restored, captured restored map and final GIS state with unchanged map view and scale.
Recorded actual final GIS URL; query left cleared.
results.reason: Second sequence is decisive. Settled map landmarks, extent and 1 km scale remained unchanged during query and after clearing; browser-derived view stayed #/-0.30002/50.85213/12.16. First sequence retained as setup evidence.

results.criterion: From the settled initial GIS view, the complete active-layer list retains its actual initial entries and order both while the `Surveyor` query is present and after it is cleared, with no new layer added; if the initial list is empty, it remains empty at both later states.
steps_taken: Navigated to launcher; opened GIS and waited for settled initial state.
First comparison was setup: initial last-row screenshot was clipped; cleared query and restarted this criterion from launcher without adding/removing any layers.
Captured second launcher initial state and settled complete 37-entry baseline list using top plus four overlapping scroll views, including the fully visible last Unwind Polygons row.
Restored list scroll to top and entered Surveyor; captured filtered catalogue and complete layer list using the same scroll views.
Restored list scroll to top and cleared query; captured restored catalogue and complete layer list with the same scroll views.
Verified complete DOM-rendered list names and order identical at baseline, query-present and query-cleared states.
Captured final decisive GIS state at bottom of complete list and current URL; restored initial layer-list scroll to top and captured cleanup.
results.reason: All 37 existing layers retained their names and order; no layer added. Baseline was populated. Second continuous sequence is decisive; earlier captures are setup only.
